description:
The Solo Plus steps up the game with a sealed rear cassette and real Premium street tires. Building it around a fully convertible frame was a good move, but adding chromoly cranks with a sealed Mid BB, and Odyssey Twisted pedals makes this one of the best deals in BMX, hands down.
Premium frame with a chromoly down tube, Mid BB shell, internal head tube
Odyssey Twisted plastic pedals
8" rise bar (on 20.5") or 8.25" (on 21") with alloy front load stem
Three-piece 175mm chromoly 8-spline cranks with sealed Mid BB
25/9 gearing
Premium Street tires; 2.25" front, 2.0" rear
Premium Slim padded seat w/ built-in alloy post
Alloy sealed bearing cassette hub with 9T driver and 14mm axle

components.description: 3 pc. tubular Crmo 175mm w/sealed MID BB
1 1/8" Crmo Threadless steer tube - w/Hi-ten tapered legs
Hi-ten - 8" rise w/20.5" frame, 8.25" rise w/21" frame
36H alloy sealed 3/8" Frt, 36H Alloy sealed cassette rear 14mm w/9T driver
Alienation 36h Deviant dw front/36h Black Sheep dw rear, 36H alloy sealed 3/8" Frt, 36H Alloy sealed cassette rear 14mm w/9T driver
Premium slim padded one piece seat with built in post
